summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of 4 new features: Spanish Offer Page Link, Second Payment Reminder, Payday Celebration Card, and Supplier Scorecard. All features are working correctly with proper mobile responsiveness at 375px.
passed_tests: Spanish Offer Page Link: Language switch on Plan page (Patel card) works correctly, Spanish chip appears in Outbox, 'Open Spanish offer page' button with lang=es parameter, offer page renders in Spanish with 'Aceptar', 'Rechazar', 'Contraoferta' buttons

Second Payment Reminder: Reminder box appears for Johnson Kitchen with $3,100 amount, due date, and reminder date 3 days before. Approve and Send now buttons work correctly, status changes from 'Needs your approval' to 'Approved' to 'Sent (simulated)', reminder appears in Outbox

Payday Celebration Card: Card correctly hidden before payroll is covered, appears after 4 counterparty responses, shows 'Payroll covered ✓', lists 4 counterparties (Lee Bathroom, Johnson Kitchen, Pacific Lumber, Patel Deck), displays cost to close gap $102.75 and $5,728 to spare, Copy summary button triggers toast notification

Supplier Scorecard: Scorecard displays on Buy page with Pacific 96%, Bayside 88%, East Bay 91% on-time records, shows recent orders for each supplier. Quote cards show on-time record (96% · 25 orders for Pacific), reliability adjustment (Bayside +$117.95 → $3,487.95, Pacific none), Pacific marked as Recommended

Mobile Responsiveness (375px): Dashboard Payday Card has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=347, clientWidth=347), Threads Reminder Box has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=311, clientWidth=311), Buy Scorecard has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=345, clientWidth=345)
